alt: A PDF text frame being edited in place with its formatting controls visible.
caption: Edit existing PDF text and preserve mixed formatting.
what: Open the public rich-text fixture. Select a mixed-format heading, edit two words, and keep the page, text frame, Layers panel and text controls visible.

alt: PDF page thumbnails being reordered in the page organiser.
caption: Append, reorder, rotate and remove pages.
what: Use a public multi-page fixture. Show the page organiser during a reorder with the insertion marker visible and one rotated page thumbnail.

alt: A PDF redaction preview showing which text will be removed.
caption: Preview a redaction before applying it.
what: Use the redaction E2E fixture. Show a selected match, the redaction preview and the count of other matches before applying.

alt: A scanned PDF with recognised text selected and the signing panel open.
caption: Select recognised text in scans and add a visible signature.
what: Use the public OCR scan fixture. Select one recognised word and open the signing panel with a visible signature preview; do not expose private certificates.

caption: Open, edit, organise, redact and export one PDF.
what: Record one continuous workflow using public fixtures: open a PDF, edit text, reorder a page, preview a redaction and export. Keep pointer movement deliberate.

alt: The image editor showing grouped layers, masks and clipping masks.
caption: Layers, groups, masks and clipping masks in the internal build.
what: Open a synthetic campaign artwork. Show a named group, pixel mask, vector mask, clipping mask, colour labels and the layer-search field.

alt: A curves adjustment layer and live filter stack in the image editor.
caption: Adjustment layers and a reorderable live filter stack.
what: Use the adjustment E2E scene. Show Curves above a Basic adjustment and an expanded live-filter stack with at least sharpen and blur.

alt: A product photograph with a locally generated subject mask being refined.
caption: Local subject selection followed by Refine Edge.
what: Use a redistributable product photo. Show the generated subject mask in Refine Edge with the before/after boundary visible; name the active local model in the panel if the UI exposes it.

alt: A 200-megapixel image document with 20 layers open in the Linux desktop build.
caption: The measured 200-megapixel, 20-layer acceptance document.
what: Run the documented 200 MP / 20-layer acceptance fixture in the Linux Tauri build. Show the full layer count, document dimensions and an active adjustment without terminal windows.

alt: A short image editing workflow in the internal desktop build.
caption: Build and export a four-artboard campaign graphic.
what: Record the core-task campaign workflow: place a photo and SVG, add styled text, create four artboards, then export WebP and PNG from the single export dialog.
